'''''Tanacetum mucronulatum''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the daisy family [[Asteraceae]], [[endemic]] to central and northern [[Portugal]]. It inhabits edges of woods and ''[[Quercus coccifera]]'' and hedges, on ultrabasic, [[schist]] or [[limestone]] soils.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tanacetum mucronulatum (Hoffmanns. & Link) Heywood |url=https://flora-on.pt/#/1Tanacetum+mucronulatum |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=6 April 2021}}</ref>
